race.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
race.verdict: NEWSREADER arrives in form and is selected to snap a lengthy losing run, with his good draw and tactical versatility offering insurance against a possible lack of pace; Intervention is feared most as a well-handicapped multiple course winner, though his wide draw complicates matters, while in-form veteran Split Elevens is also expected to be involved in the outcome. NEWSREADER (IRE) INTERVENTION SPLIT ELEVENS
